title: feat(approvals,mcp): an approver's agent lists the approvals waiting on them over MCP
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwJx2CfBxrD3ojeDPr _Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D2vQDw3PttZBH5mQttmcfFL)_ Fixes #32442 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**:审批人的 MCP 代理现在能列出「等我审批」的单子并直接批。三处改动:① MCP 的五个读工具放行声明了 `enable.aiReadable: true` 的系统对象(写工具照旧全部拒绝 `sys_*`),`sys_approval_request` 声明了它;② 按你的 1B,成员默认权限集 `member_default` 给审批请求加只读,看哪几行仍由审批读闸门决定(提交人、当前审批人、经手人);③ 按你的 2B,读闸门在查询写成「`pending_approvers` 包含我的 id」时,用审批服务自己的地址折算来回答,所以按邮箱、按无人在岗的职位寄出的单子也能找到。控制台的「我的待审」视图用的是同一个过滤,也一起修好。另外:审批请求的活动记录与审计记录副本做了加固,见 GHSA-2985-5f64-8wgh;已有旧记录的批量改写命令列为后续(owed)。加固带来一处收窄:在活动记录或审计日志上,钉住审批请求、又按副本列筛选或全文搜索的查询,现在要求读者能看到所有对象的所有字段,否则拒绝(包括被屏蔽了任一字段的组织管理员);钉住别的对象、或不碰副本列的查询不变。成员现在能在自己参与的审批请求上看和发通用评论,这是 1B 的后果,席位已接受。 - **为什么改**:#32442 读半边你裁了 A(6837430865)和 1B + 2B(6849636735)。1B 取代了决定 6840464379 的一条:成员现在能在数据接口上读到自己参与的审批请求行,请求的对象定义也随之对所有成员可见;审批动作记录 `sys_approval_action` 不变,仍只经审批委托提供定义、数据侧仍关闭。 - **风险与回滚**:不参与某张单子的成员看不到它(查询、按 id、聚合、对象列表都测了);任何 `sys_*` 对象都不开写;字段屏蔽照旧(审批人拿不到他没权限的快照字段)。回滚即撤本 PR。 - **先看**:① `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/request-read-gate.ts` 的 `splitWaitingOnCaller` 和闸门里的改写;② `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts` 新加的一行;③ `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` 的 `readGuard`。 - **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/request-read-waiting-on-caller.integration.test.ts`,预期 7 条全过:按 id 寄出的审批人只拿到自己那张;按职位寄出的单子,职位持有人用查询、计数、分组计数都拿到;局外人和提交人什么都拿不到。 - **需要你做的**:无,合约复审由 triage#1 做,席位落地。 ## What changes **Read admission (ruling A).** - `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`. `McpDataBridge` gains an optional member `aiReadExposed(name): Promise`. A new `readGuard` guards the read tools only (`describe_object`, `query_records`, `get_record`, `aggregate_records`): the existing `guard`, except that a `sys_*` name the bridge attests is admitted. `list_objects` lists a `sys_*` object only where the same attestation holds. Fail-closed: a bridge without the member, or one whose answer throws, keeps every system object refused and unlisted. The write tools, `validate_expression` and the file tools keep `guard`, unchanged. `query_records`' description gives the "waiting on you" filter on `sys_approval_request` as an example. - Both bridges answer with `isAiReadExposed` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, #32865) over the whole served definition: `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` (HTTP) and `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` (stdio). The stored-metadata family answers `false` before the key is read; only the boolean `true` opens. - `sys_approval_request` declares `enable: { aiReadable: true }`. `sys_approval_action` declares nothing. **Members read their requests (ruling 1B).** - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`: `member_default` names `sys_approval_request` with `allowRead: true` and every write `false`, after `sys_activity`, following the #30108 precedent (the baseline names a plugin object; the plugin's own gate decides rows). The rows a member reads are still `request-read-gate.ts`'s participant set: the submitter, a current approver, a past actor. **"Waiting on me" answered with the approvals fold (ruling 2B).** - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/request-read-gate.ts`: `splitWaitingOnCaller(where, userId)` takes out a conjunctive (root, or inside a root `$and`) `pending_approvers: { $contains: }`, exactly that single operator. The gate replaces it with `id in `, from a new `RequestVisibilitySource.waitingOnCallerIds(context)`, and then narrows to the participant set as for every read. A predicate naming another id, using another operator, or under `$or` is read as written. - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`: `waitingOnCallerIds` answers with `approverRequestIds(actingAddresses(caller), org)`, the same fold and pending-approver index the inbox already uses (`approver-address.ts`; no second fold). The index holds rows only while a request is pending, so a decided request leaves the answer. - The engine resolves `{current_user_id}` before the gate runs, so the console's `my_pending` list view and an MCP `where` take the same path. **`@objectstack/plugin-audit`: the activity and audit copies of approval requests are hardened** (GHSA-2985-5f64-8wgh). `side-copy-columns.ts` lists, by object, the columns no ledger copy carries. The writer (`ledgerView`) omits them from new `sys_activity` / `sys_audit_log` copies, and `side-copy-migration.ts` (`migrateSideCopies`, `migrateArchivedSideCopies`, on the shared ledger-copy runner, in the key-material rewrite's shape) rewrites the copies at rest. Both ledgers' read redactions drop the listed columns from an older copy, whether or not the rewrite has run. **Who can query those copies narrows:** a non-system query on `sys_activity` or `sys_audit_log` that names `sys_approval_request` by equality on `object_name` and names a column holding the copy (`metadata`; `old_value`, `new_value`), as a free-text search does, is judged against every registered object (`reachesSideCopy`), as a query naming no object already is. A reader withheld any field of any object, an organization administrator included, is refused it (`403`) where `main` answers it. The same query pinned to another object, or naming only other columns, is judged as before; a reader served every field of every object (the stock administrator the existing admin-search pins boot) is answered as before. The guard's header, refusal remedy and fail-closed warning say so. This does not depend on the rewrite having run. **Owed:** the `os migrate` door for that rewrite, as a follow-up card. **What 1B supersedes in decision 6840464379.** That decision served the two request definitions through `schemaReadDelegate: 'approvals'` while the rows stayed closed to members on the data door. After 1B: the `sys_approval_request` definition reaches every member through the baseline read (projected by their field security), and its rows reach the participants on the data door; `sys_approval_action` is unchanged (definition by the delegate, rows closed). The delegate stays on both objects for a deployment that withdraws the baseline line. `approval-request-schema-party-read.dogfood.test.ts` is re-grounded to exactly that, and `action-door-api-forward-denied-subject.test.ts` withdraws the one baseline line so its denied-load forward is still the thing under test. **Statements this PR made false, corrected:** the schema-read note in `sys-approval-request.object.ts`, the no-middleware warning in `approvals-plugin.ts`, the denied-load note in `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`, and `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` (the visibility callout and the record-page paragraph). The spec prose at `object.zod.ts` goes to a follow-up. **`list_objects` cost.** The HTTP bridge answers every `aiReadExposed` ask of one request from one merged read (pinned: three asks, one `getMetaItems`). **Docs and changeset.** `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` and `packages/mcp/README.md` state the read opt-in, the member read and the slot coverage; `query_records`' text gives the approvals filter as an example. `.changeset/mcp-read-tools-ai-readable-system-object.md`: `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/plugin-approvals`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit` patch, with both declaration lines. ## Tests - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-read-over-mcp.dogfood.test.ts` (new, 8 tests): real `SecurityPlugin`, flows, approvals and MCP plugins over the live `/mcp` transport. No permission set in the file names `sys_approval_request`: every member holds the shipped baseline and an app set. One flow waits on the approver addressed by **email** and, once approved, stamps the record; another waits on a **team**. The approver's "pending for me" returns exactly their two requests with the inbox row's display fields (process and step label, submitter, record); the team member's returns exactly the team's; the submitter's returns nothing, though their untargeted read returns all three; a member on no request reads nothing by query, by id or by aggregate (`n: 0`); the capability-gated masked field in the snapshot is not served to the approver but is to the submitter who holds the capability; `list_objects` lists `sys_approval_request` as the only `sys_*` object; the three write tools are refused and `sys_approval_action` stays refused; the tool text names the filter; end to end, the submitter files over MCP, the approver lists, approves with `run_action` and confirmation, the request is `approved`, the flow resumes down its approve edge and stamps the record, and the pending list shrinks to the other request. - `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/request-read-waiting-on-caller.integration.test.ts` (new, 7 tests, real ObjectQL over better-sqlite3 and the real plugin `start()`): a user-id slot gives the approver exactly that request; a request whose slot is the unstaffed `position:

` literal is found by its holder via find, count and grouped count; an outsider and the submitter get nothing; a predicate naming another id is left literal and still narrowed; a decided request leaves the answer; pure `splitWaitingOnCaller` cases. - The dogfood also pins the request's copies (10 tests now): its activity copies are written without the listed column, and a copy in the older shape, still at rest, reaches the approver on no read face (list, query, aggregate, count and sort). `plugin-audit`: `side-copy-columns.test.ts` (new, 7: the list, `constructor` and other inherited names unlisted, both rewrite planners idempotent, the guard's reach, the ledger redaction) and `activity-side-copy-redaction.test.ts` (new, 5), and `side-copy-migration.test.ts` (new, 4: `migrateSideCopies` dry run writes nothing; apply rewrites only the listed object's copies in both tables, keeps every other key, column and `updated_at`, and a re-run rewrites none; the `objects` option; `migrateArchivedSideCopies` over a real SQL archive store, idempotent). - `packages/mcp/src/mcp-system-object-ai-read.test.ts` (new, 16 tests), `packages/runtime/src/mcp-system-object-ai-read.test.ts` (new, 7 tests, one merged read for several asks), `sys-approval-request.object.test.ts` (declaration pins), and two bridge-member tripwires classifying the new member as a no-row-body read. **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each on a committed head, each restore verified `blob == HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty): | Ablation | Result | |:--|:--| | A1: `readGuard` admits nothing (`return bad;`) | the four "reaches the bridge" pins red (4 failed, 12 passed) | | A2: the runtime bridge answers `false` | "answers true for a system object that declares aiReadable: true" red (1 failed, 5 passed) | | A3: the `aiReadable: true` line removed | the declaration pin red (1 failed, 17 passed) | | 1B: the `member_default` line removed (plugin-security rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` proved the grant gone from `dist/`, and present again after restore) | dogfood 7 failed, 1 passed: every member read answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` | | 2B: the gate's rewrite disabled (`if (false)`) | integration: the position-literal pin red (1 failed, 6 passed); dogfood: the email-slate approver's pending list, the masked-field read through it, the aggregate `n: 2` and the end-to-end pins red (4 failed, 4 passed) | | W: the writer's `omitSideCopyFromCopy` call removed (plugin-audit rebuilt) | dogfood: the written-copy pin red (1 failed, 9 passed) | | G: the guards' `reachesSideCopy` condition removed (plugin-audit rebuilt) | dogfood: the at-rest faces pin red (1 failed, 9 passed) | | R: the activity read redaction's side-copy drop disabled (plugin-audit rebuilt) | dogfood: the at-rest list face red (1 failed, 9 passed); `activity-side-copy-redaction.test.ts` 2 failed | The team-addressed pin stays green under the 2B ablation: a team slot is expanded to its members' user ids when the step opens, so it never depended on the fold. It pins the outcome, not 2B. ## Acceptance notes - **Step 0 on main code.** The same dogfood with `@objectstack/mcp` built from `4462b4d9`: every read of `sys_approval_request` answered `Object "sys_approval_request" is a system object and is not exposed via MCP`. After admission alone (report 6848413320): `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` for a member (F1), and an email-addressed approver's "pending for me" returned 0 rows under a test grant (F2). The maintainer ruled 1B + 2B (6849636735); with both, the pins above are green with no test grant. - **Red lines.** - A member on no request sees nothing: by query, by id (not found), by aggregate (`n: 0`). `list_objects` carries no row counts (its `totalCount` counts objects), so it lists the object to every member and serves no rows. Pinned in the dogfood and the integration test. - An approver sees exactly their inbox rows, including email- and position-addressed slates (and team, by expansion). - No write opens on any `sys_*` object: the write tools keep `guard`, pinned per tool over MCP; the member baseline line grants read only. - Field masking still applies: pinned on the capability-gated snapshot field. - **Narrowing in the GHSA-2985-5f64-8wgh fix:** the query rule above refuses, for a reader withheld any field of any object, a request-pinned ledger query naming a copy column that `main` answers. It is part of the fix, for the seat's ACCEPT. - **Seat-accepted consequence of 1B:** a participant can now read and post `sys_comment` threads on a request they are party to (the generic comment door needs only the parent read). `enable.feeds` stays as on `main`: declaring it `false` would refuse administrators' comment writes, which `main` accepts. - **Serial.** Draft PR #33057 edits other description text in `mcp-http-tools.ts`; `main` was merged once (`a596c03c`) and merges cleanly now. The 18.4.0 merge freeze has lifted. ## Verification Head `b6acbd9a9b`: `33368c3153` (the guard's words, the rewrite tests, the changeset's query rule, after round 3's PASS 6862530251) and one merge of `main` (29 commits, no conflict). **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on `b6acbd9a9b`: 107 derived, 107 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, all 107 exit 0. Before round 2's head two reds were fixed: `check:cli-command-ids` on a command name in the rewrite's report text, and the administrators' ledger-search pins under a first guard design that judged every ledger query reaching a request against every object. The scoped rule keeps those pins green unchanged; it still refuses, for a reader withheld any field of any object, the request-pinned copy-column query described above. **Package suites** on `b6acbd9a9b`, each under `os-verify-lock`, after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a turbo build of the dogfood, runtime and verify closures: | Command | Result | |:--|:--| | `node scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs` | exit 0 | | `pnpm --filter typecheck` for plugin-audit, plugin-approvals (both with `check:test-typecheck`), mcp, runtime, dogfood | all exit 0 | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` | 1495 passed | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test` | 1632 passed | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` | 1121 passed | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` | 10584 passed, 19 skipped | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test` | 6605 passed, 45 skipped | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify test` | 437 passed | | `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run` on the 52 dogfood files that name `sys_approval_request`, `sys_activity` or `sys_audit_log` | 390 passed | **Not run here.** The CI-only families that `dispatch-gates` lists outside the derived total: Build Core, the full dogfood shards (the 52 files above stand in for them), the Temporal live-DB jobs, and the type-check lanes. _Body refreshed 2026-11-13T20:25Z for the final push after contract review round 3 (6862530251)._ --- 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_016WV4cwJx2CfBxrD3ojeDPr
